name: smartbuild-v2
description: SmartBuild v2 - GoHighLevel marketplace app platform

scripts._comment_start: start/src-index is a legacy Node entry — the app runs on Workers via wrangler (cf:dev / cf:deploy); local dev uses wrangler dev below.
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy: npm run cf:deploy && npm run verify:deploy

_comment_esbuild_advisory: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (esbuild 0.18.20, moderate) is ACCEPTED, not unfixed-by-neglect. It arrives only via drizzle-kit -> @esbuild-kit/esm-loader -> @esbuild-kit/core-utils, which pins esbuild ~0.18.20. drizzle-kit 0.31.10 IS the latest and still depends on it, so there is no upgrade path; `npm audit fix --force` offers drizzle-kit@0.18.1, a 13-minor downgrade of our migration tool. The advisory needs esbuild's DEV SERVER to be running (it lets any site read its responses); drizzle-kit only uses the loader to transpile drizzle.config.js and never starts one, and this is a devDependency that never reaches the Worker bundle. An npm `overrides` pin was tried and npm 11.13.0 did not apply it. Re-check when drizzle-kit completes its move to tsx (it already depends on both).
